title: 1000xRESIST
tagline: A story of sisters, shells, and the Orchard — talk to everyone before the scene moves on, then choose the future.
order_note: In story order, with each chapter's talk-to-everyone achievement placed in its chapter and the Orchard landmarks grouped with Chapters 2–4 (they're explorable from Chapter 2). The talk achievements must be done before each section's confirmation interaction — most characters can't be spoken to twice, so sweep with the compass before confirming. Endings are all chosen in the epilogue: view the five An Endings first, then the two Epitaphs; Chapter 10 via chapter select cleans up the rest.
scope_note: Full game: all 32 achievements / 1,000G. No TrueAchievements walkthrough exists, so route notes are paraphrased from the Steam 100% guide; about 12–15 hours.

achievements.name: I want you to see from the beginning
achievements.how: Finish the prologue chapter.

achievements.name: Her name was Iris
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 1.

achievements.name: Saying your goodbyes
achievements.req: Talk to all characters in the High School in Chapter 1
achievements.how: Talk to everyone in the High School in both time periods before the chapter moves on — unlock time travel first (Gymnasium, Rooftop, Gym Door, Jiao's Picture), then sweep with the compass; Jiao's don't count, and most people can't be spoken to twice. It pops when you start talking to the last person.

achievements.name: I've been thinking about family
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 2.

achievements.name: Perform your function, Watcher
achievements.req: Talk to all characters in the Orchard in Chapter 2
achievements.how: Talk to everyone in the Orchard before moving on — Bang Bang Fire doesn't count. Use the compass to find stragglers.

achievements.name: We were all the new kid once
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 3.

achievements.name: Happy Birthday!
achievements.req: Talk to all characters in the Orchard in Chapter 3
achievements.how: Talk to everyone in the Orchard — the Healer doesn't count this time.

achievements.name: It's a part of growing up
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 4.

achievements.name: You're a Big Sister, now
achievements.req: Talk to all characters in the Orchard in Chapter 4
achievements.how: Talk to everyone in the Orchard, but do NOT talk to Helpful Shell/Fixer in The Bar first — that advances the story. You can enter and leave the bar without talking to them.

achievements.name: In the ground
achievements.how: From the waterfall on Level 1, turn right at sign '1' (don't take the stairs), pass sign 'C', the ALLMOTHER heads, and the alcove; at the spine statue turn left into the 'Grove' doorway, then left up the escalators.

achievements.name: How does it make you feel?
achievements.req: Find the horse statue in the Orchard
achievements.how: Take stairs 'D' by the waterfall, turn right, and follow the overhead signs to the Horse Lobby.

achievements.name: A prayer room
achievements.req: Find the pillar room in the Orchard
achievements.how: Left of the waterfall into the glass walkway (Shrine Courtyard), straight past the white arch, right up the wooden spiral stairs, then the grey stairs on the left — don't cross the bridge — into the prayer room.

achievements.name: I think it's a fox
achievements.req: Find the skull shrine in the Orchard
achievements.how: Left of the waterfall into the Shrine Courtyard, first right through the white arch.

achievements.name: Do some self-reflection
achievements.req: Find the mirror shrine in the Orchard
achievements.how: Take stairs 'D' by the waterfall and turn left toward the mirror shrine.

achievements.name: I always find you, don't I?
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 5.

achievements.name: I want you to call me Blue
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 6.

achievements.name: A clone about town
achievements.req: Talk to all characters in Old Town in Chapter 6 Part 1
achievements.how: After seeing the Bartender at The Bar but before returning her ingredients, talk to everyone in Old Town.

achievements.name: Destroy The Provisional Government
achievements.how: In Chapter 6, after gaining upstairs privileges and finishing the required tasks, take your seat in the audience to complete 'Attend The Play'.

achievements.name: Somebody has to tend bar
achievements.req: Talk to all characters in Old Town and the Orchard in Chapter 6 Part 3
achievements.how: Talk to everyone in Old Town and the Orchard in Chapter 6 Part 3 — the Red Shells outside the residence don't count, but you must speak to at least one Jiao-Type.

achievements.name: 噉慢慢爬囉 (Then just slowly crawl)
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 7.

achievements.name: Sometimes you don't fit in the backpack
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 8.

achievements.name: Our own path to blood
achievements.how: Finish Chapter 9.

achievements.name: Pacific 50 Descend
achievements.req: Talk to all recordings of members of The 50 in Chapter 9
achievements.how: Talk to every recording of The 50 across floors -16 to -01 in Chapter 9 — the guide lists them floor by floor; use the compass to catch stragglers.

achievements.name: Let this thread be…
achievements.how: Finish Chapter X.

achievements.name: An Ending: Scorched Earth
achievements.how: In the epilogue, turn off every light (Parents may stay on) and confirm with Secretary.

achievements.name: An Ending: Her Name Is Not Mauve
achievements.req: An Ending: Her Name Is Not Mauve
achievements.how: In the epilogue, leave Mauve's light on and confirm with Secretary.

achievements.name: An Ending: The Law
achievements.how: In the epilogue, turn off Mauve's light (Red Guard stays on) and confirm with Secretary.

achievements.name: An Ending: Lights Out
achievements.how: In the epilogue, turn off Mauve, Red Guard, and Sisters, then confirm with Secretary.

achievements.name: An Ending: Justice For Jiao
achievements.how: In the epilogue, turn off Mauve, Red Guard, and Jiao (Sisters on), then confirm with Secretary.

achievements.name: Ending: Epitaphs (Blue)
achievements.how: In the epilogue, turn off Mauve, Red Guard, and Principal (Sisters and Jiaos on), then confirm with Secretary.

achievements.name: Ending: Epitaphs (Red)
achievements.how: In the epilogue, turn off Mauve and Red Guard only (Sisters, Jiaos, and Principal on), then confirm with Secretary.

achievements.name: Hekki Allmo
achievements.how: View the epilogue through either Epitaphs ending. Watch all five An Endings first — they return you to the final scene so you can change the lights; after your first finish, Chapter 10 via chapter select lets you collect the rest.
